units.title: Understand AI and choose useful tasks
units.competency: Separate useful assistance from decisions that need human judgment.

units.title: Frame the problem and protect the inputs
units.competency: Write a usable brief while excluding unnecessary personal information.

units.title: Give instructions and improve the draft
units.competency: Develop and test instructions against explicit criteria.

units.title: Verify claims, sources, and numbers
units.competency: Trace important claims to evidence and recompute calculations.

units.title: Design a workflow with human checkpoints
units.competency: Create a repeatable process with failure handling and approval.

units.title: Communicate with clarity and judgment
units.competency: Edit a draft for audience, evidence, and a useful next action.

units.title: Document responsible use and prove transfer
units.competency: Explain AI assistance and apply the same principles to a different task.

units.title: Build, defend, and package the final project
units.competency: Deliver a bounded AI-assisted workflow with evidence of independent judgment.
